in_sanskrit.name: महाकाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahakala (Sanskrit: महाकाल, IAST: Mahākāla) is a Hindu deity, a form of Lord Shiva, and the god of time and the cosmic procession of time. The name is derived from Maha, meaning great, and Kala, meaning time.

in_marathi.name: Mahakaleshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Great Lord Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahakaleshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahakaleshwar is a name of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration in Hinduism. The name Mahakaleshwar signifies the great time-keeper and destroyer of illusions and ignorance.
